title: scTWAS in colorectal cancer: analysis code, curated peak sets and trained GReX models
description:
Code and data accompanying Single-cell transcriptome-wide association study in colorectal cancer. The deposit covers construction of the single-cell references and cis-xQTL mapping for three donor cohorts, cell-type accessible-chromatin peak calling, elastic-net training of the cell-type models of genetically regulated expression (GReX), S-PrediXcan association testing against the CRC GWAS meta-analyses, colocalization and SMR-HEIDI, construction of the cell-type-specific TF-target networks, orthogonal support from single-cell, spatial (GeoMx and CosMx), TCGA and CPTAC data, drug-target annotation and iLINCS connectivity analysis, the arrayed siRNA and CRISPR-Cas9 viability screens, and figure and supplementary-table assembly.

This record also carries the bulk files kept out of the git repository: the 23 trained per-cell-type GReX model databases (*_peakSNP.db, PredictDB format) and the raw per-group accessible-chromatin peak calls. The curated peak sets used for model training are in the repository under data/.

Two components of the published workflow are not included and are documented in docs/known_gaps.md: the DepMap dependency retrieval and statistics, and a shared normalisation helper module. Individual-level genotype and single-cell expression data are not released; see the article's Data availability statement.
